hero.headline: Technology for Agroecology
hero.subhead: We build offline-first software, vernacular voice tools, and open data commons with women-led farming collectives.
hero.aiLine: Yes, AI built this website—because our hands are busy building tools for women in agroecology.

kaithota.name: Kai Thota OS
kaithota.desc: Offline-first, bilingual (English/Kannada) crop planning, biodynamic sowing, and harvest tracking for collective farms.

pgsoc.name: Peer-Verified Organic Certification (PGS) & Farmer Onboarding Tools
pgsoc.desc: Peer-verified organic certification and farmer onboarding tools built for decentralized group integrity without paperwork friction.

commons.name: Open Agroecology Commons
commons.desc: Shared agronomy knowledge, native seed taxonomies, and community-owned field schemas ensuring smallholders own their historical data.

s1.name: Participatory Field-Tech Co-Design
s1.desc: Software built shoulder-to-shoulder with women farmers in the field, adapting technology to human rhythms rather than forcing bureaucratic routines.

s2.name: Custom Collective Software
s2.desc: Operational tools for Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs), Participatory Guarantee System groups, and decentralized food networks.

s3.name: Field Data Migration & Audits
s3.desc: Turning physical paper registers, WhatsApp voice notes, and messy spreadsheets into structured, audit-ready farm records.

asr.name: Offline Vernacular ASR
asr.desc: Voice-first speech recognition for Iruliga and Lambani dialects so typing or literacy never blocks field logging.

livingLab.name: Living Lab
livingLab.desc: Continuously tested on active agroecology plots.

openSource.name: Open Source
openSource.desc: Public repositories and documentation coming soon for the global agrarian commons.

about.title: About
about.p1: Buffalo Back Labs (OPC) Private Limited was founded by Preethy Iyer in Bengaluru. We are an independent software lab dedicated to grassroots agroecology and food sovereignty.
about.p2: We work field-first and voice-first, with zero third-party AI data egress. Our code serves the soil and the women who sustain it.

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem & Collaborations
ecosystem.desc: We work alongside farmer collectives, FPOs, PGS clusters, conservation trusts, and public interest research foundations across the Global South.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.desc: If you are a farming collective, a researcher, or an impact partner interested in our field tools or voice models, we would love to hear from you.
